title: OrchestralAgentProtocolV1WireBundle
description:
A schema-only root that gathers the independently transported v1 messages
into one deterministic document and one shared `$defs` namespace.

AgentAdmission.description:
Final resource admission after the adapter has resolved every binding that
must be available before native work starts.

AgentCapabilities.description: Capabilities are promises and must be checked by conformance tests.

AgentDescriptorEnvelope.description:
Immutable capability promise selected for a Run. A Provider configuration
change must produce a new descriptor digest (and normally a new binding).

AgentEventAuthority.description:
Authenticated origin stored beside a normalized journal event. Authority is
Host journal metadata, not a field supplied by an Agent Provider.

AgentEventDraft.description: Unsequenced durable fact submitted to the host journal.

AgentId.description: Agent implementation/profile identifier within a provider.

AgentJournalRecord.description:
Durable input to replay. `run_seq`, the event digest, and authority must be
committed atomically by the Host journal.

AgentProtocolError.description: Structured protocol failure. This is distinct from an Agent run failure.

AgentProtocolErrorCode.description: Stable protocol error code suitable for RPC adapters.

AgentProviderStreamItem.description:
Provider observation before Host journal sequencing. The Provider supplies a
stable event ID; only the Host journal may assign normalized `run_seq`.

AgentRejection.description: A start rejection does not create an Agent execution.

AgentRunEnvelope.description:
Digest-bearing transport envelope. Keeping the digest outside the spec
avoids a self-referential canonical representation.

AgentRunSpec.description: Immutable execution boundary for one logical Agent run.

AgentRunState.description: Public state derived from phase, continuity authority, and pending requests.

AgentRunView.description:
Stable, bounded Host read model for `inspect(run)`. Unbounded committed
output history is read separately through journal pagination bounded by
`last_run_seq`.

AgentStartRequest.description:
Host-selected immutable Provider contract for starting a run. Binding the
descriptor in the request prevents describe/start time-of-check drift.

evidence.description:
Bounded semantic evidence selected by the Host. Raw Tool arguments
and results must never be copied here wholesale.

ApprovalGrantRef.description: Approval grant reference issued by the host.

ArtifactRef.description: Artifact identifier independent of physical storage.

oneOf.description: The provider accepts cancellation but cannot prove the final native state.

The provider emits an authoritative cancellation or competing terminal.
A disconnect/Unknown outcome does not satisfy this capability.

CommandAck.description: Host control API acknowledgement derived only from committed journal facts.

CommandId.description: Idempotency identifier for a control command.

recover.description:
Provider-native stream recovery. Host journal replay is always a
separate Orchestral responsibility.

Digest.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest used for immutable protocol bindings.

currency.description: ISO 4217-style uppercase currency code, for example `USD`.

PartialDelivery.description:
Partial output attached to an incomplete run. It cannot be accepted as a
successful [`AgentDelivery`] because the types are intentionally distinct.

session_approval_scope.description:
Opaque Host review class that may be remembered for this
interactive session. It never replaces the exact operation digest
or the single-use approval grant.

ProtocolVersion.description: Version of the public Agent Protocol wire contract.

supporting_event_ids.description:
Non-authoritative trace hints. Every ID must name a prior durable event
in this Run; existence does not prove that the event caused the output.

ProviderBindingRef.description: Stable host-side provider binding; never a provider-native session id.

ProviderCommandDisposition.description:
Provider-native response. It never contains Host journal sequence numbers
and cannot claim that a causal effect has been durably applied.

RequestId.description: Correlation identifier for a blocking or non-blocking request.

ResourceBinding.description: Immutable resource visibility binding. It never conveys effect authority.

ResourceBindingId.description: One resource binding in a run specification.

ResourceId.description: Opaque resource identifier resolved by the host or adapter.

ResourceKind.description:
Open, namespaced resource kind such as `workspace-view/v1`.

MCP is intentionally not a kind: an MCP adapter publishes ordinary tools
into a `tool-catalog` resource. Skill and tool domain types remain separate.

RunId.description: One logical Agent execution within a session.

RunLimits.description: Limits have protocol meaning only when a provider declares support.

ToolActivityEvidence.description:
Bounded, Host-selected evidence about one Tool operation.

This is deliberately semantic rather than a copy of arbitrary Tool JSON:
adapters describe their own operations, while Agent clients only aggregate
and render the stable evidence vocabulary.

ToolActivityId.description: Stable identifier for one Tool activity across state transitions.
